points: Only one agency fully completed its cryptographic inventory; none tested PQC in production environments
18 agencies lack cryptography expertise, 19 have no automated discovery tools
Public version of a sensitive report with 89 recommendations
take: A useful benchmark for your own PQC programme: the gaps are inventories, funding and testing, driven by missing crypto skills and discovery tools.
title: GAO: none of 24 US agencies is fully ready for post-quantum crypto
